# Docker
> Docker provides container tooling, images, registries, and application development workflows for building, shipping, and running software.

Docker’s ecosystem spans Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, Build Cloud, Scout, hardened images, and extensive documentation for container development, image management, security, and deployment workflows.

## Documentation
- [Docker Docs](https://docs.docker.com/): Main documentation portal for Docker products, guides, manuals, and references.
- [Get Started](https://docs.docker.com/get-started/): Introductory learning path for building, running, and sharing containers.
- [Manuals](https://docs.docker.com/manuals/): Product manuals covering Docker Desktop, Engine, Hub, Build, Scout, and more.
- [Reference](https://docs.docker.com/reference/): Command, file format, and specification references for Docker tooling.
- [Samples](https://docs.docker.com/samples/): Example applications and sample projects for learning Docker workflows.
- [Glossary](https://docs.docker.com/glossary/): Definitions for common Docker, container, and image terminology.

## Docker Desktop
- [Docker Desktop Overview](https://docs.docker.com/desktop/): Documentation for installing, configuring, and using Docker Desktop.
- [Install Docker Desktop](https://docs.docker.com/desktop/install/): Installation instructions for macOS, Windows, and Linux environments.
- [Settings Management](https://docs.docker.com/desktop/settings-management/): Configure and manage Docker Desktop settings across teams and environments.
- [Extensions](https://docs.docker.com/extensions/): Build, install, and use Docker Desktop extensions.
- [Hardened Docker Desktop](https://docs.docker.com/enterprise/security/hardened-desktop/): Security-focused guidance for deploying Docker Desktop in enterprise environments.
- [Release Notes](https://docs.docker.com/desktop/release-notes/): Version history, changes, fixes, and known issues for Docker Desktop.

## Docker Engine and CLI
- [Docker Engine](https://docs.docker.com/engine/): Documentation for the Docker Engine runtime and daemon.
- [Install Docker Engine](https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/): Installation guides for Docker Engine on supported Linux distributions.
- [Docker CLI Reference](https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/docker/): Command reference for the top-level docker CLI.
- [Dockerfile Reference](https://docs.docker.com/reference/dockerfile/): Complete reference for Dockerfile instructions and syntax.
- [Compose File Reference](https://docs.docker.com/reference/compose-file/): Specification and reference for Docker Compose files.
- [Builder Reference](https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/docker/builder/): CLI reference for image build and builder-related commands.

## Docker Compose and Development
- [Docker Compose](https://docs.docker.com/compose/): Documentation for defining and running multi-container applications.
- [Compose Getting Started](https://docs.docker.com/compose/gettingstarted/): Learn core Compose workflows with a practical example application.
- [Develop with Containers](https://docs.docker.com/get-started/docker-concepts/the-basics/what-is-a-container/): Introductory concepts for container-based application development.
- [Multi-Container Applications](https://docs.docker.com/get-started/workshop/08_using_compose/): Tutorial for running and managing multi-container apps with Compose.
- [Compose CLI Reference](https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/docker/compose/): Command reference for docker compose subcommands and options.
- [Compose Bridge](https://docs.docker.com/compose/bridge/): Tools and guidance for converting Compose applications to other targets.

## Build, Images, and Registries
- [Build Documentation](https://docs.docker.com/build/): Guides for image builds, BuildKit, and advanced build workflows.
- [Build Cloud](https://docs.docker.com/build-cloud/): Documentation for Docker Build Cloud remote build infrastructure.
- [Buildx](https://docs.docker.com/build/buildx/): Extended build capabilities for multi-platform and advanced image builds.
- [Docker Hub Docs](https://docs.docker.com/docker-hub/): Documentation for repositories, images, organizations, and Hub features.
- [Docker Hub](https://hub.docker.com/): Registry for discovering, storing, and distributing container images.
- [Docker Official Images](https://docs.docker.com/docker-hub/official_images/): Information about curated, maintained official Docker images.
- [Docker Hardened Images](https://docs.docker.com/dhi/): Documentation for Docker Hardened Images and secure base image usage.

## Security and Supply Chain
- [Docker Scout](https://docs.docker.com/scout/): Documentation for image analysis, vulnerability insights, and remediation workflows.
- [Image Access Management](https://docs.docker.com/security/for-admins/hardened-desktop/image-access-management/): Control which container images users can access in Docker Desktop.
- [Registry Access Management](https://docs.docker.com/security/for-admins/hardened-desktop/registry-access-management/): Restrict registry access for managed Docker Desktop environments.
- [Enhanced Container Isolation](https://docs.docker.com/security/for-admins/hardened-desktop/enhanced-container-isolation/): Strengthen isolation boundaries for containers running in Docker Desktop.
- [Content Trust](https://docs.docker.com/engine/security/trust/): Sign and verify image publishers using Docker Content Trust.
- [Scout CLI Reference](https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/docker/scout/): Command reference for Docker Scout CLI functionality.

## API and Reference
- [Docker Engine API](https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/): HTTP API reference for interacting programmatically with Docker Engine.
- [Docker Hub API](https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/hub/latest/): API reference for Docker Hub repositories, organizations, and related resources.
- [Registry API](https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/registry/): Reference for the Docker Registry HTTP API.
- [Docker Debug CLI Reference](https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/docker/debug/): Command reference for Docker Debug functionality.
- [Docker Init CLI Reference](https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/docker/init/): Command reference for initializing Docker assets in projects.
- [Docker Scout CLI Reference](https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/docker/scout/): Detailed CLI reference for Docker Scout commands.

## Guides and Tutorials
- [Docker Workshop](https://docs.docker.com/get-started/workshop/): Hands-on tutorial for containerizing and sharing an application.
- [Language-Specific Guides](https://docs.docker.com/guides/): Development guides for popular languages and frameworks using Docker.
- [Java Guide](https://docs.docker.com/guides/java/): Build, containerize, and develop Java applications with Docker.
- [Node.js Guide](https://docs.docker.com/guides/nodejs/): Build and run Node.js applications using Docker workflows.
- [Python Guide](https://docs.docker.com/guides/python/): Containerize and develop Python applications with Docker.
- [Go Guide](https://docs.docker.com/guides/golang/): Build and package Go applications into Docker images.

## Products and Platform
- [Docker Desktop](https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/): Desktop application for local container development and management.
- [Docker Hub](https://www.docker.com/products/docker-hub/): Hosted registry and collaboration platform for container images.
- [Docker Scout](https://www.docker.com/products/docker-scout/): Security and supply chain analysis for container images.
- [Docker Build Cloud](https://www.docker.com/products/build-cloud/): Managed remote build service for faster image builds.
- [Testcontainers Cloud](https://www.docker.com/products/testcontainers-cloud/): Cloud acceleration for integration tests using Testcontainers.
- [Docker Hardened Images](https://www.docker.com/products/hardened-images/): Enterprise-focused secure container images for production use.

## Community and Learning
- [Docker Blog](https://www.docker.com/blog/): Product updates, tutorials, engineering posts, and community announcements.
- [Docker Community](https://www.docker.com/community/): Community programs, events, and ways to connect with Docker users.
- [Docker Forums](https://forums.docker.com/): Community discussion forum for troubleshooting and product questions.
- [Docker YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@Docker): Video tutorials, demos, webinars, and product announcements.
- [Docker Training](https://www.docker.com/resources/trainings/): Training resources and learning materials for Docker users.
- [Docker Open Source Program](https://www.docker.com/community/open-source/): Support and benefits for open source maintainers using Docker.
